summary: This is a letter from Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) to the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited, dated June 20, 2025.  The letter transmits a press release announcing TCS's expansion in Europe with the launch of three new hubs focused on software-defined vehicle innovation.  The letter is signed by Yashaswin Sheth, Company Secretary of TCS.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced the opening of three new automotive hubs in Europe to accelerate Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) innovation.  Two new Automotive Delivery Centers in Munich and Villingen-Schwenningen, Germany, will support the development and deployment of TCS's software services for autonomous driving, infotainment, safety systems, and connected vehicle technologies.  An engineering center in Romania will focus on designing advanced automotive software platforms.  These centers, employing over 100 professionals and complementing TCS's existing 2000+ SDV engineers globally, will collaborate with European OEMs to support the entire SDV product lifecycle.  TCS highlights the strategic importance of its European expansion, emphasizing its 25-year history serving automotive clients in the region and leveraging technologies like Generative AI to enhance innovation and personalization in the SDV space. The expansion underscores TCS's commitment to supporting the automotive industry's shift towards software-defined, connected, and autonomous vehicles.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is a global digital transformation and technology partner celebrating over 45 years of presence in Europe.  With over 15,000 employees across 62 European offices, TCS serves major multinational companies in various sectors, including banking, finance, manufacturing, telecom, retail, travel, and logistics.  TCS's global presence includes 607,979 consultants in 55 countries and 202 service delivery centers.  The company emphasizes long-term client partnerships and generated US$30 billion in revenue in fiscal year 2025.  They are also known for their sponsorship of major marathons worldwide.
